**US March 2026 revenue by stream (USD):**

| Stream | Account | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Subscription | 4000 | 52,300.00 |
| Usage | 4100 | 977.00 |
| Professional services | 4200 | 7,500.00 |
| **Total** | | **60,777.00** |

**The trail — 8 posted entries, all with support attached:**

*Subscription (net 52,300):* JE-00222 Acme 18,000 · JE-00224 Corvid 11,500 · JE-00219 Fairview 9,400 · JE-00215 Beacon 8,000 · JE-00225 Evergreen 6,200 = 53,100 gross, less JE-00275 Beacon SLA credit memo CM-0031 (800).

*Usage (977):* JE-00236 — Acme INV-2180, API overage billed in arrears.

*Professional services (7,500):* JE-00255 — Fairview INV-2118, implementation services.

Each stream total equals the GL period activity for its account exactly, and every entry is source "ar" hitting AR against revenue — no top-side adjustments. 4800 and 4900 had zero March activity, so 60,777 is total US March revenue, not just these three streams.

**Completeness checks:** the document store holds exactly 7 March US revenue documents plus the credit memo; all 8 tie 1:1 to the entries above, with no unbilled document and no unsupported entry. Deferred revenue (2200) and unbilled receivables (1300) both had zero March activity and zero balances, so nothing is sitting in a deferral or contract asset that belongs in these numbers.

**Two things worth your attention (I changed nothing):**

1. **Usage cut-off.** Usage is billed in arrears and recognized in the billing month. INV-2180 (3/04, in March) is described as *February* usage, but INV-2120 (2/03, in February) is *also* described as February. Amounts differ (977 vs 844), so these are two distinct periods, not a duplicate — but one description is mislabeled. If INV-2180 really is February consumption, actual March usage is unaccrued. No April invoice exists yet, so I could not quantify or support an accrual and did not book one. The revenue accountant should confirm service periods.
2. The 800 SLA credit relates to a February incident but landed in March — correctly classified, period only, immaterial.

**Caveat:** the US "Revenue recognition" checklist item is still open, so these are pre-close-adjustment figures. The other open items (bank recs, depreciation, prepaids, payroll, AP cutoff) touch expense and balance sheet accounts only, so subject to point 1 I expect the 60,777 to hold.
